newsitem.title: USA: St. Jude says adopts new rights agreement.
newsitem.headline: St. Jude says adopts new rights agreement.

text.p: St. Jude Medical Inc said its board approved a new rights agreement replacing an earlier amended and restated rights agreement that terminated April 7.

The rights will be exercisable only if a person or group acquires 15 percent or more of St. Jude Medical's common stock or announces a tender offer which, if consummated, would result in ownership by a person or group of 15 percent or more of the common stock, St. Jude said.

"Each right will entitle shareholders to buy one one-hundredth of a share of the company's junior participating preferred stock at an exercise price of $200. The term of the rights agreement is 10 years," the company said.
